input.subject: Kitchen extractor fan – Flat 1, 31 Juniper Mews (ref R/PM017-1)
input.body:
Dear Clara,

Re: kitchen extractor fan, Flat 1, 31 Juniper Mews, Cedarford, ZZ7 7ZZ (ref R/PM017-1)

The landlord has let us know that the extractor fan has its own switch to the right-hand side of the hob, which needs to be switched on for the fan to work.

Could you please check that switch, turn it on, and try the fan again? Please reply to let us know whether the fan now works. If it still doesn't turn on, tell us and we'll take it back to the landlord to arrange for someone to look at it. If there's any burning smell, sparking or scorch marks, please don't use it and let us know straight away.

We'll check back with you in 3 days if we haven't heard from you.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
